notes.title: 🩸 Major Update for Everdark: Undead Apocalypse – The Darkness Reborn! 🩸

items.text: Survivors, one of the biggest updates since the launch of Everdark: Undead Apocalypse has arrived!
Our team has been hard at work pushing the experience to the next level, upgrading both the visuals and the core gameplay. Here’s everything that’s new in this Major Update:

We’ve implemented a completely new rendering system that significantly enhances lighting, shadows, and material quality. The world of Everdark now feels more immersive, atmospheric, and visually striking.

notes.title: Stealth now plays a crucial role

items.text: You can approach each level without being seen thanks to new silent movement options, alternative routes, and enemy behaviors that react more realistically to your actions. Sneak past vampires like never before!

notes.title: For players seeking a true challenge

items.text: Increased overall difficulty
More aggressive enemies
Your entire arsenal unlocked from the start
A new way to experience Everdark for seasoned survivors.
Vampires and other night creatures now make smarter decisions, coordinate attacks more effectively, and react more precisely to sound, light, and movement.
We’ve addressed a large number of community-reported issues, improving overall stability and gameplay consistency.
The flashlight now projects more realistic light, with better diffusion, more natural shadows, and behavior that increases tension in dark areas.
Many maps have been reworked to be more aesthetic, immersive, and rich in small environmental details that deepen the world’s atmosphere.
This update marks a new chapter in the fight to survive the eternal night!
See you in the shadows… 🩸
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297034/18d2a2b314915fd53a1f47a565060586eb270c53.jpg"]

Following the launch of Everdark: Undead Apocalypse, we’ve been closely watching your reviews and gameplay videos. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve identified a few bugs that managed to slip past our internal testing.

We want to deliver the best possible experience, so we’re working hard on an upcoming update that not only fixes these issues but also adds improvements and extra content we had originally planned for release.
🔧 Improvements and Fixes Included in the Upcoming Patch
New stealth mechanics to kill enemies without being detected.
Adjusted difficulty level.
Improved door physics: you can now use doors with gaps to escape from vampires and attack them from safe positions, balancing the difficulty in key sections.
Enhanced enemy AI: enemies now behave more realistically and present a better challenge.
Adjusted player capsule: fixes strange collisions and gameplay interruptions.
Fixed enemy materials: certain materials now behave correctly.
Environment updates: redesigned areas such as the Briggs cabin, the crypt, the convenience store, and some puzzle elements.
Improved enemy animations: they look (and feel) much more terrifying now!
Performance optimization: especially in the hospital level, where some players experienced drops in performance.
Enhanced lighting and overall color grading for a more immersive atmosphere.
🔓 New Content: “New Game + ”
Once you complete the main story, you’ll unlock New Game Plus mode — a chance to revisit the streets of Everdark from the very beginning with your full arsenal unlocked.
Expect tougher enemies, but also more resources to face the challenge.
OUT NOW!!!
